items.title: Amgen (AMGN) Faces Patient Data Breach And Tavneos Review Risk
items.summary: Amgen (NasdaqGS:AMGN) has reported a major cybersecurity breach that exposed sensitive patient health information. At the same time, regulators are reviewing the clinical data supporting its rare inflammatory disease drug Tavneos, following the retraction of a pivotal publication. Together, the data breach and questions over Tavneos data raise regulatory, reputational, and operational risks for Amgen. items.title: Amgen (NASDAQ:AMGN) Delivers Strong Q2 CY2026 Numbers, Guides for Strong Full-Year Sales
items.summary: Biotech company Amgen (NASDAQ:AMGN) beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 9.5% year on year to $10.05 billion. The company’s full-year revenue guidance of $38.8 billion at the midpoint came in 2.8% above analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $6.29 per share was 12% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
